decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a close variant of the firm's established drainage offer, so its in-house R&D and drainage know-how let it read early results and refine the line.
A shower channel for seamless coverings sits at the core of the firm's expertise, has its own web page, and fits the trend toward barrier-free bathrooms.
Pump-assisted drainage adds some unfamiliar technology, but it builds on the firm's drainage base and its own R&D gives enough related knowledge to absorb the new elements.
The tileable floor drain is closely related to the firm's existing products, is presented on its own page, and benefits fully from its accumulated know-how.
